name: Everything is Gun!
description:
About This Game

YOUR SURVIVAL IS THE SPECTACLE. WHAT WILL BE LEFT OF YOUR SOUL?

"Prisoner number 11 18 1978 909,

Welcome to the A1-KTRZ! You’ve been convicted of first-degree murder and conspiracy. You are sentenced to life in prison on this planet. My codes and protocols are not programmed to express empathy for you or those you’ve wronged. To me, you are an organic. To you, I am The Warden.

You will be stripped of all of your human rights. You killed 909 people. Now you can hone your skills in the Labyrinths, ever-changing battlefields and arenas designed for you to fight, suffer, and be brought back to endure the torment over and over again...

Your struggle to survive will be broadcasted to billions of other organics for their amusement. One day, if there is anything left of your body, you may be pardoned and leave this place. Until then, you are deprived of dreams, hopes, and expectations.

From now on you belong to A1-KTRZ!”

- The Warden


DOMINATE IN A BRUTAL, LIGHTNING-FAST OLD-SCHOOL FPS

Step into a relentless, biomechanical world built on the unapologetic, high-stakes speed of the 90s - an era where your movement was your only shield and every kill felt earned, not gifted. In Everything is Gun!, movement is the heartbeat of the experience, trading modern cinematic hand-holding for 100+mph momentum, perfect air-control, and zero aim-assist. There are no sprint buttons and no cover mechanics; your agility is your only armor. Navigate a chaotic bullet hell with razor-sharp precision, chaining lightning-fast dashes and pixel-perfect flick shots to outpace the carnage. As you stack augments, your Uplift suit evolves, scaling your speed and jump height to turn the shifting world of A1-KTRZ into a vertical playground for pure skill expression. Paint the walls with your enemies - because in this world, if you stop moving, you die.

ISAAC-STYLE SYNERGIES. NO BORING STAT BUFFS. ONLY DRASTIC ALTERATION.

Imagine a world where your hand is not just a tool, but the ultimate, ever-evolving arsenal. In Everything is Gun!, we don't just do +5% damage tweaks - we do weapon-breaking mutations where every augment you collect fuses directly into your raw limb, layering on top of the last to unlock unforeseen lethal capabilities. Strategically engineer, stack, and assemble apocalyptic weapon systems unique only to your run. 

Imagine starting with a basic pea-shooter, but you’ve strategically architected it to:

  • Volley into a sweeping wall of death that guarantees no target can hide.

  • Bounce off walls, gaining devastating velocity to shred flesh on every ricochet.

  • Trigger a corrosive poison cloud on impact that completely melts enemy armor.

  • And detonate every casualty into an arena-shattering explosion - but who cares if you level the map? You never play the same layout twice.

That is just one blueprint. Experiment with piercing electricity, black holes, and time-dilation fields. Outsmart the Warden, claim your absolute power, and build synergies so broken they feel illegal.

CONQUER A RUN, INVADE OTHER PLAYERS’ GAMES, AND RISE TO GLOBAL SUPREMACY

Your greatest run is about to become someone else’s worst nightmare. Through our Asynchronous Revenge system, you don't just climb a static leaderboard - you become a living, breathing threat. The moment you complete a run with a game-breaking god build, the network captures your exact loadout, your precise movement patterns, and your lethal synergies, uploading you into the multiverse as a Ghost Boss. You will bridge into other players' sessions globally, hunting them down with the very weapons you perfected. Imagine unleashing your ultimate engine of destruction to obliterate your friends in their own games, triggering a relentless cycle of high-stakes vengeance, social rivalries, and your absolute dominance on the global stage. Outsmart The Warden, build your legacy, and annihilate all challengers.

CLAIM YOUR SPOT ON THE JOURNEY

No cinematic CGI trailers, no fake marketing hype - just raw, early development footage. What you see right now are the core building blocks of a game that will only get faster, louder, and deadlier.

Everything is Gun! is in its early pre-production phase, and we are gearing up for a Q4 2027 launch. We want the hardcore community on the front lines with us from the very start. Hit the Steam Playtest button to secure your spot in upcoming tests, join our Discord to talk directly with the team, and help shape the game's future.

Become part of the foundation today. Wishlist now!
short_desc: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?
